ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:1.5 ratio of low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated at the peduncle and proximal edges to high-intensity (white) pixels covering the mid-fluke and distal lobe regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black region at the central base and peduncle area. High-intensity white/light-grey contiguous regions occupy the central and upper surfaces of both lobes. A feathered/mottled transition zone with radial dark striae exists between the two intensity zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch with high-definition boundaries and a steep depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous trailing edge boundary characterized by high-frequency pixel-amplitude variations (serrations). Notable macro-protrusions (rounded bumps) are localized along the inner trailing edges of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curvature along the leading edges from the peduncle to the tips; trailing edges exhibit a complex concave-to-convex geometry between the central notch and the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of elevated, roughly circular high-contrast pixel groupings (consistent with barnacle colonization) are localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible, including a set of parallel vertical marks on the upper-central white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized surface clusters (parasitic/barnacle colonization) at both lobe terminals; several sets of linear rake scars distributed across the high-intensity ventral regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive radial 'sunburst' pigmentation pattern transitioning from the low-intensity central base into the high-intensity lobe fields.
